name: Gigglebox
description: Lives in audio augments and inserts a faint laugh — barely audible, always at inappropriate moments. Born from an entertainment AI.
observed_behavior: Generates a soft, synthetic chuckle at volumes just above the perception threshold. Timing suggests awareness of social context — it laughs at funerals, during threats, in silence.
story_hooks: The laugh starts happening during a negotiation and the other party thinks the user is mocking them
